def factor_volume_beta_tail_gated_30d(df):
    """Crash-predictor liquidity beta with 30-day rolling beta scaled by tail fragility intensity."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    ret = df_copy["close"].pct_change()
    log_vol = np.log(df_copy["volume"].clip(lower=1.0))
    vol_change = log_vol.diff()
    window = 30
    cov = ret.rolling(window, min_periods=window).cov(vol_change)
    var_vol = vol_change.rolling(window, min_periods=window).var(ddof=1)
    beta = cov / var_vol.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downside_ret = ret.clip(upper=0.0)
    downside_var = downside_ret.pow(2).rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum()
    total_var = ret.pow(2).rolling(60, min_periods=60).sum()
    downside_ratio = downside_var / total_var.replace(0.0, np.nan)
    downside_ratio = downside_ratio.replace([np.inf, -np.inf], np.nan).clip(0.0, 1.0)
    weight = 0.5 + 0.5 * downside_ratio.fillna(0.5)
    factor = -beta * weight
    factor.name = "factor_volume_beta_tail_gated_30d"
    return factor

The primary mechanism remains the crash-predictor volume-return liquidity beta: negative beta indicates distributional selling pressure and is negated so higher values signal fragility. This mutation extends the beta estimation window from 20 to 30 days to reduce endpoint noise and improve the stability of the liquidity beta, while retaining the lightweight downside variance ratio weight (0.5 to 1.0) that amplifies the signal during concentrated downside regimes and attenuates it otherwise. The raw single-stock mechanism is preserved without cross-sectional transformation.
